title: Business Gates
subtitle: Gates G0–G7 with their criteria, evidence, decisions and exceptions. Each gate passes only on the server's evaluation.
taskHint: Task completion never unlocks a gate: a gate passes only with evidence accepted by the criterion reviewer, approved exceptions and a final authorized decision.

incorporation.unverified: Reported incorporated; evidence not yet verified.

perimeter.verified: All in-scope items transferred with verified evidence.
perimeter.in_progress: {verified} of {inScope} in-scope items verified; {pending} item(s) with pending disposition.

readiness.standalone_reassessment: The standalone acceptance (G4) is under controlled reassessment: evidence it relied upon changed.
readiness.tsa_blocked: {tsaProblems} TSA(s) breached or expired without an accepted exit.
readiness.blockers_failed: {failedBlockers} blocking readiness check(s) failed or improperly waived.
readiness.dependencies: Dependencies: {active} transitional service(s) not yet exited, {enduring} approved enduring arrangement(s).
readiness.definition_pending: The definition of operational independence is not yet approved.

jv.not_started: No partner, signing or closing recorded.
jv.closing_conditions_in_progress: Signing confirmed; {inProgress} closing(s) in preparation (conditions precedent being satisfied).
jv.signing_ready: Gate G5 (JV Signing Readiness) approved; the signing is not yet recorded.
jv.diligence_and_negotiation: Due diligence, negotiation or signing preparation in progress.
jv.partner_preparation: Partner preparation in progress (before due diligence).
jv.terminated: Every partner withdrawn and every signing / closing aborted.
jv.aborted_excluded: {aborted} aborted signing / closing event(s) not counted.

blocker.evidence_conflict: Criterion {criterion} has conflicting evidence requiring reassessment
blocker.met_without_evidence: Criterion {criterion} is marked met but has no active evidence
blocker.not_applicable_undetermined: Criterion {criterion} is marked not applicable without an approved specialist determination
blocker.no_decision: No approved governance decision is linked to gate {gate}
blocker.decision_other_gate: The linked decision was raised for gate {decisionGate}, not {gate}
blocker.decision_recommended: The linked decision is recommended — pending the external authority; it is not a final approval and the gate stays blocked
blocker.decision_not_approved: The linked decision is {status}; only an approved decision can back a gate approval
blocker.decision_external_unrecorded: The linked decision is outside the committee delegation and no approval by the authorized body is recorded
blocker.decision_external_evidence_missing: The approval by the authorized body recorded on the linked decision has no evidence link; it cannot back the gate
blocker.decision_external_evidence_invalid: The evidence of the approval by the authorized body recorded on the linked decision is now {status}; the decision no longer backs the gate
blocker.decision_external_evidence_unverified: The evidence of the approval by the authorized body recorded on the linked decision is not verified by a second person
blocker.decision_no_authority: The linked decision has no authority assessment (within mandate / external authority)
blocker.decision_no_gate: The linked decision was not raised for a gate; only a decision raised for gate {gate} can back it
blocker.decision_no_matrix: The deciding committee has no approved authority matrix, so its decision cannot back gate {gate}
blocker.decision_type_missing: The linked decision has no decision type; the approved authority matrix must assign its type to gate {gate}
blocker.decision_type_unknown: Decision type {decisionType} is not in the approved authority matrix of the deciding committee
blocker.decision_type_not_for_gate: The approved authority matrix does not assign decision type {decisionType} to gate {gate}
blocker.decision_body_not_authorized: Decision type {decisionType} is reserved to a higher authority; the committee approval alone cannot back gate {gate}

closing.no_signing: No signing is linked to this closing.
closing.cp_verified_without_evidence: Blocking condition {ref} is verified without active evidence.
closing.cp_waiver_not_effective: Blocking condition {ref} is waived without an effective approved waiver.
closing.cp_validity_lapsed: The validity of condition {ref} lapsed on {date}.
closing.cp_long_stop_passed: The long-stop date {date} of condition {ref} has passed.

counts: {met} met · {waived} waived · {na} not applicable · of {total} criteria

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.none: No blockers — the criteria and prerequisites are satisfied.
blockers.decision: No final authorized decision backs this gate

reassessment.title: Controlled reassessment requested
reassessment.body: Evidence relied upon for {criteria} is now conflicting. The approval of this cycle is preserved; an authorized person decides whether to reopen the gate as a new cycle.
reassessment.upstream: Upstream gate approval under reassessment: {gates}. Review whether this gate still stands.

decisionEvidence.evidence_defective: The evidence of the external authority's approval of decision {decision}, on which this approval relied, was rejected as defective. The decision and this cycle are preserved; an authorized person decides whether to reopen the gate.
decisionEvidence.evidence_superseded: The evidence of the external authority's approval of decision {decision}, on which this approval relied, was superseded. The decision and this cycle are preserved; an authorized person decides whether to reopen the gate.
decisionEvidence.evidence_conflict: The evidence of the external authority's approval of decision {decision}, on which this approval relied, is now conflicting. The decision and this cycle are preserved; an authorized person decides whether to reopen the gate.

actions.approverOnly: Only the gate approver ({role}) records this decision.
actions.ownerOnly: Only the gate owner ({role}) or the project manager starts, submits or links a decision for this gate.
actions.reviewerIsStarter: You started this cycle, so another holder of the gate reviewer role must review it.

start.title: Start assessment — {gate}
start.effect: The current cycle moves to In assessment; criteria can be worked on.
start.parallel: Starting an assessment does not require prerequisite gates to be approved (preparation may run in parallel).

markReady.title: Submit for decision — {gate}
markReady.effect: The cycle moves to Ready for decision; the server re-checks every criterion, evidence and prerequisite now.
markReady.notReady: The server will refuse: {count} blocker(s) remain.
markReady.frozen: Criteria are frozen until the gate is sent back to assessment.
markReady.endorsed: The gate reviewer's endorsement of the current assessment is recorded.
markReady.needsEndorsement: The server will refuse: the gate reviewer ({role}) has not endorsed the current assessment.
markReady.notReviewer: The person who endorsed the assessment cannot submit it.

back.title: Back to assessment — {gate}
back.effect: The cycle returns to In assessment so criteria can change.

link.title: Link governance decision — {gate}
link.effect: The chosen committee decision is linked to this cycle.
link.blocked: A recommendation pending external authority, or any decision that is not finally approved, keeps the gate blocked.

review.title: Review assessment — {gate}

effect.endorse: The assessment of this cycle is endorsed; its owner may then submit it for decision.
effect.return: The assessment is returned to its owner for rework; it cannot be submitted until it is endorsed.

review.stale: Any later change of evidence, criterion status, waiver or applicability makes an endorsement out of date.
review.incomplete: The server will refuse the endorsement: some criteria are not satisfied yet — return it instead.
review.sod: You may not review a cycle you started, and the person who endorses cannot submit or decide the gate.

decide.title: Gate decision — {gate}

effect.approve: The gate is approved for this cycle.
effect.approve_with_exceptions: The gate is approved with its recorded waivers visible as exceptions.
effect.reject: The gate is rejected for this cycle.

decide.recheck: The server re-evaluates criteria, evidence and prerequisites at decision time.
decide.finalOnly: An approval needs a final governance decision: approved within mandate, or approved by the authorized body.

reopen.title: Controlled reopen — {gate}
reopen.effect: A new assessment cycle {cycle} is created in status Reopened.
reopen.preserved: Cycle {cycle}, its status, decision and evidence snapshot are preserved unchanged.
reopen.newDecision: Passing the gate again requires a fresh review and a new final decision.
reopen.resetHint: Selected criteria start the new cycle as Unmet; criteria with conflicting evidence start as Conflicting.

decide.decisionHint: Decisions raised for this gate and visible committee decisions. The server checks that it is final and belongs to this project.

decision.title: Governance decision
decision.none: No decision is linked to the current cycle.
decision.notVisible: A decision is linked but you cannot view it.
decision.final: Final authorized decision — it can back the gate approval.
decision.notFinal: Not a final authorized decision — the gate stays blocked.
decision.rule: The gate is decided by the {role}, who must be neither the person who submitted it nor the gate reviewer.

review.title: Gate review

stateHint.not_reviewed: The gate reviewer ({role}) has not reviewed the current assessment.
stateHint.endorsed: The gate reviewer ({role}) endorsed the current assessment; it can be submitted for decision.
stateHint.returned: Returned for rework by the gate reviewer ({role}); a new endorsement is needed.
stateHint.stale: A criterion changed after the endorsement; the gate reviewer ({role}) must review the current assessment again.

review.rule: Reviewed by the {role}, who must not have started the cycle; the owner then submits it and the approver decides — the reviewer does neither.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.hint: Mandatory criteria must be met with evidence accepted by the reviewer, waived by an approved waiver (only if waivable) or determined not applicable by the reviewer role.

criterion.frozen: Criteria of this cycle cannot change in its current state.

na.pending: Not applicable — proposed, awaiting determination by the {role}. It does not count until approved.

evidence.title: Evidence (Document & Evidence Center)
evidence.unavailable: Evidence is not available to you.

cycles.title: Assessment cycles
cycles.hint: A reopen creates a new cycle; earlier cycles and their decisions are never modified.

waivers.title: Exceptions register (waivers)
waivers.hint: Every waiver records its basis, impact, approver authority and decision. Non-waivable criteria refuse waivers.

evidence.title: Add evidence — {criterion}
evidence.effect: The evidence is linked to the criterion in the Document & Evidence Center.
evidence.unverified: It stays unverified until reviewed by someone other than you.
evidence.documentHint: Only documents you can read are listed.

submit.title: Submit evidence — {criterion}
submit.effect: The criterion moves to Evidence submitted (active evidence is required).
submit.reviewer: The {role} reviews it; you cannot accept your own evidence.

met.title: Accept as met — {criterion}
met.effect: The criterion is recorded as Met in this cycle.
met.rules: Refused if there is no active evidence, if evidence conflicts, or if you added the evidence yourself.

return.title: Return as unmet — {criterion}
return.effect: The criterion returns to Unmet and blocks the gate if it is mandatory.

proposeNa.title: Propose not applicable — {criterion}
proposeNa.effect: The criterion is proposed as not applicable with your basis.
proposeNa.determination: It keeps blocking the gate until the {role} (not you) approves the determination.

approveNa.title: Approve not applicable — {criterion}
approveNa.effect: The specialist determination is recorded and the criterion stops blocking.
approveNa.rules: Only the {role} may determine it, and not the proposer.

rejectNa.title: Reject not applicable — {criterion}
rejectNa.effect: The proposal is rejected and the criterion returns to Unmet.

waiver.title: Request waiver — {criterion}
waiver.effect: A waiver request is sent for approval by the {role}.
waiver.nonWaivable: This criterion is non-waivable: the server refuses and logs the request, and the criterion stays unmet.
waiver.nonWaivableWarning: Specialists determined that this criterion is non-waivable. An exception cannot override it; a request will be refused and logged.
waiver.notSelf: You cannot approve your own waiver.
waiver.impactHint: Schedule, cost, risk and transaction impact.

waivability.title: Waivability determination — {criterion}
waivability.waivable: The criterion becomes waivable; waivers need approval by the {role}.
waivability.nonWaivable: The criterion becomes non-waivable; pending waivers can no longer be approved.
waivability.versioned: The determination is versioned; the previous one stays in the history.
waivability.basisHint: Name the specialist assessment behind this determination.

approveWaiver.title: Approve waiver — {criterion}
approveWaiver.effect: The criterion is recorded as Waived in this cycle and the gate shows the exception.
approveWaiver.rules: Only the {role} may approve, never the requester, and only while the criterion is waivable.

rejectWaiver.title: Reject waiver — {criterion}
rejectWaiver.effect: The waiver is rejected and the criterion stays as it is.

dimensions.independent: Each dimension moves on its own evidence; one being complete never completes the carve-out.
dimensions.explanationLanguage: The computed explanation is provided by the server in English.
dimensions.complete: All dimensions have reached their terminal state.
dimensions.notComplete: The carve-out is not complete: other dimensions are still pending.
dimensions.registerUnavailable: The contributing register is not available to you.
dimensions.recomputeEffect: The four dimensions are recomputed from the registers now; changes are versioned.

refusal.decisionEvidenceInvalid: The evidence of the external authority's approval recorded on this decision is no longer active and verified (for example it was rejected as defective). The decision no longer backs the gate.
refusal.reviewStale: The criteria changed after the gate reviewer's endorsement. The owner sends the gate back to assessment for a fresh review before it is decided.
refusal.decisionReused: This decision is already linked to an earlier cycle of the gate (approved or rejected). A later cycle needs a fresh committee decision.
